modesDescription.das: p + q1 weight (dtheta*cosAlpha/d) + accW norm (production legacy baseline)
modesDescription.legacyW: b + q1 weight + accW norm (fair legacy-weight pairing, was "wrong")
modesDescription.ubpD: b + solid-angle weight (dtheta*R*cosAlpha/d^2) + accW norm (proposed pairing)
modesDescription.ubpP: b + solid-angle weight + raw-sum with C_P calibration (physical scale, separate)
modesDescription.saP: p + solid-angle weight + accW norm (factorial completion)

fixedFactors: same input signals p/pp, geometry, interpolation, maskOob, angle sampling, amplitude calibration and metrics across all modes; only the stated factor differs
derivativeConvention: dF/dt along dim1 via timeDerivative.m: central difference interior, one-sided ends, per-column; verified by test_time_derivative.m
fwhmConvention: sampled along actual radial (center->peak) and tangential directions; invalid when no half-height crossing or peak at window edge
